_help: Controls tools/build_release.py (CurseForge-safe build). A piece/pool/structure type is 'third-party' unless it is OWN (script-built), VANILLA, or confirmed here.
_confirmed_mine_help: tokens: 'gearwrights', 'village_houses' (the custom kubejs village house sets), 'brutos', 'vsrevamped', or 'kubejs' (= every kubejs-provided namespace). Only add what YOU made or have written permission for.
_permission_granted_help: substrings of mod jar names whose author gave permission, e.g. 'tarbound', 'windswept'. Matches the provider shown in docs/provenance_audit.md.
